_doc: Recurring characters drawn in rooms and scenes (not the talking heads: heads.json). A room or scene part names one with "character" and takes its prompt, negatives, seed and settings; the part's own keys win. One description and one seed per character keep it the same person everywhere.

atreides-guard.title: Atreides palace guard
atreides-guard.prompt: 1980s science fiction film still, full body of a male Atreides house guard at attention, rugged clean-shaven man, square jaw, smooth steel dome helmet, retro-futuristic grey-blue padded uniform, black leather harness, one hand on his belt, other hand holding a long black lasgun standing on the floor beside his leg, sharp focus
atreides-guard.negative_extra: three legs, three boots, extra leg, pistol, gun in both hands, woman, moustache, beard, epaulettes, medals, peaked cap, victorian, world war, historical uniform, vintage photograph, sword, cane, robe, cloak, blurry face
